referenceApp.description: Workspace-relative folder of the approved reference app, e.g. "apps/orders".

referenceEntity.description: Singular entity name used in the reference app, e.g. "Order". Guessed from the app name when omitted.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the reference app that are never copied (migrations and __pycache__ are always skipped).

requiredFiles.description: Files every app must have, checked by "Check Apps Against Reference". Defaults to the reference app's Python files.

registerInSettings.description: Add the new app next to the reference app in INSTALLED_APPS-style lists.

registerInUrls.description: Duplicate the reference app's include() entry in URLconfs.
